verdict.rationale: Because AnythingLLM runs locally/self-hosted and keeps data on-device (anythingllm-docs-1, anythingllm-docs-2), users inherently control where data lives and can delete it by removing local files or containers, and a community exchange confirms privacy-by-default with cloud use being opt-in (anythingllm-comm-11). However, there is no explicit documentation of built-in retention policies, a data-deletion UI/API, or export/purge tooling. Missing for 10: dedicated data retention/deletion settings or API, documented data lifecycle policy, independent verification of deletion behavior.
